agents.name: Muse

access.free_tier: yes — free with a usage limit that refreshes (limit not stated officially)
access.billing_note: Renews monthly on the purchase anniversary until cancelled; cancel any time. Sign in with a Meta account
access.subscription_note: Subscriptions in limited testing; not available in all locations; 18+

agents.actions: browse web, fill forms, send email, book travel, purchases, negotiate on user's behalf
agents.execution: Muse Secure VM — dedicated cloud VM holding agent + user data; Sentinel agent must approve anything that reaches the internet
agents.safety: Checks with the person before sensitive actions like sending an email or making a purchase; approval modes: Ask for some actions (every write and important read) or Always ask

privacy.training: Users can opt out of interactions being used to train Meta's models
privacy.confidential_compute: Muse Confidential VM, user-held key — announced for later in 2026 (not live)
privacy.delete_data: Delete single messages, side chats and files; Reset Muse permanently deletes everything, including chat history; deleting the Meta account deletes Muse data

agents.name: dots

access.required_plan_for_agent: ChatGPT Pro or Business Premium (Enterprise/Edu/Healthcare: beta, admin-enabled)

paid_plans.name: Pro 200
paid_plans.note: open to new sign-ups again; new subscriptions get a lower usage allowance

access.included: First dot included at no extra cost; plan includes an allowance for deeper work (extended limits first month). Extra dots: 'in the future', price not announced
access.billing_note: Pro is monthly only; no annual billing. Pro 200 is open to new subscriptions again, with a lower usage allowance for new subscribers; grandfathered Pro 200 subscribers keep their previous allowance through 2026-10-29

platforms.mobile_app: chat after setup; cannot create a dot on mobile

agents.actions: own cloud computer + browser; connected apps; scheduled/recurring tasks; proactive background research (read-only tools); optional access to user's laptop
agents.execution: Own cloud computer; user can open it to inspect work
agents.safety: Auto-review of account-affecting actions; Custom Rules (act / act if pre-approved / ask / hand off); sensitive tasks like password change always stay with user; monitoring can pause the dot

privacy.training: Personal plans: user controls whether dot conversations/work improve models. Business/Enterprise/Edu not used by default. No direct training on proactive research or dot's notes
privacy.delete_data: Reset deletes dot, conversations, memories, scheduled tasks; disconnecting an app does not delete data already obtained

agents.name: Grok Bot
agents.vendor: SpaceXAI (formerly xAI) — also distributed via Cursor

access.required_plan_for_agent: SuperGrok / SuperGrok Plus / SuperGrok Heavy / X Premium+ (linked), Cursor Pro / Pro+ / Ultra, Cursor Teams; Enterprise
access.usage_note: Grok Bot has its own usage, separate from Grok/Cursor plans; resets weekly; overage via Cursor on-demand usage

agents.actions: multi-step work across apps and websites; computer control; connectors; learns workflows from demonstration; bots coordinate with each other
agents.execution: Persistent cloud computer per bot (browser, filesystem, terminal) on Cursor's cloud; optional execution on your own computer (ask each time / always / never)
agents.safety: Asks for approval before sending messages, publishing, purchases and transfers, deleting data, changing permissions, production changes, accepting legal terms; Auto Review rules (ask-first wins)

privacy.training: Follows your Cursor account privacy settings; Legacy Privacy Mode not supported
privacy.delete_data: Deleting a bot doesn't remove files or sessions on its shared computer; retention follows Cursor terms

agents.name: OpenClaw
agents.vendor: OpenClaw Foundation (501(c)(3)); created by Peter Steinberger

access.free_tier: software free; you pay hosting + model API

agents.actions: personal assistant you message from chat apps; runs tools on the machine it's installed on
agents.execution: Runs on your own computer or server (Node.js 24.16+ or 26.1+, Docker or Nix); tools execute on the host by default
agents.safety: DM channels need a pairing approval; docs say treat inbound messages as untrusted input and read the security guide before exposing it remotely

privacy.training: Depends on the model provider you connect; OpenClaw itself has no hosted service

agents.name: Gemini Spark

access.required_plan_for_agent: Google AI Pro or Ultra, 18+, select countries (also select business users)

agents.regions: Select countries (launched in the US, then India, Australia and Canada, among others)
agents.actions: multi-step tasks across Gmail, Calendar, Drive, Docs, Sheets and other Google apps; runs in the background 24/7; can run tasks on your Mac
agents.execution: Google's cloud; keeps working when your laptop is closed or your phone is locked
agents.safety: Designed to ask you first before high-stakes actions like spending money or sending emails; app connections are off by default

agents.name: Poke
agents.vendor: The Interaction Company (joined Cognition, 2026-07 per press)
agents.actions: email (Gmail, Outlook), calendars, contacts; Notion, GitHub, Linear; builds and deploys simple websites; Ultra: Poke Human sends real-world tasks to a person

agents.name: Hermes Agent
agents.actions: creates reusable skills from experience; keeps its own memory; runs commands in local, Docker, SSH or cloud sandboxes
agents.execution: Self-hosted: your computer, a VPS, a GPU cluster or serverless
agents.safety: Command approval, DM pairing and container isolation (per docs)
agents.model: any — Nous Portal, OpenRouter, OpenAI or a custom endpoint

agents.name: Hark Pro

access.free_tier: yes — all features included, with a usage cap; exact allowance and reset schedule not publicly stated

paid_plans.name: Hark Pro²
paid_plans.note: Advertised dollar price; checkout determines currency and local price

paid_plans.name: Hark Pro³
paid_plans.note: Advertised dollar price; checkout determines currency and local price

access.included: All features are offered in every plan; paid tiers increase usage
access.billing_note: Monthly paid subscriptions renew automatically; website cancellation at least 24 hours before period end. Optional auto top-up with a user-set amount and ceiling. App-store prices may differ
access.subscription_note: 18+, or the higher minimum age required locally

agents.actions: browser errands and purchases; calendar and email work; Projects with files; custom Panels; suggested Action Buttons; repeatable Specialties; scheduled and conditional tasks

agents.safety: By default asks before spending money or sending communications, unless you grant standing permission; watch and cancel browser actions; scheduled tasks can be paused or cancelled

privacy.training: Terms permit content use for improvement and development; safety/compliance training and quality assurance may continue after opt-out. Third-party model providers may not train on your content
privacy.delete_data: Ask Hark to review, edit or delete memories. Delete Account in Settings → Profile; legal and security retention exceptions apply

agents.model: Handoff for computer use; full model lineup not stated

agents.name: Airtap

access.free_tier: yes — free during the current release, with a daily usage cap; cap size not published. Invite only
access.billing_note: Terms say paid subscription tiers are planned for a future release; no prices published

agents.actions: operates real mobile apps on a cloud Android phone: clips coupons and card offers, books classes and reservations, tracks prices, posts to social apps, orders rides and groceries; saved routines run on a schedule
agents.execution: A dedicated Android phone in the cloud, always on and signed in to your apps; optional AutoPilot app (Android, sideloaded) controls your own phone. A SKILLS.md file lets Claude, Codex or OpenClaw drive an Airtap phone
agents.safety: You sign in to your own apps; Airtap says it never sees or stores passwords, the agent is blocked from reading password and card fields, each phone runs in an isolated container and sessions are wiped on logout. Web app shows a live view and step history

privacy.training: Task text, conversation history and cloud-phone screenshots go to Google (Gemini), Anthropic, xAI, OpenAI, Groq and AssemblyAI, which the policy says do not train on it. Terms allow anonymized, aggregated usage data for model improvement
privacy.delete_data: Data processed on your device is kept up to 30 days unless a routine stores results; usage logs up to 12 months; early deletion on request

agents.model: Third-party models from Google (Gemini), Anthropic, xAI, OpenAI, Groq and AssemblyAI; routing not stated
